title: Hot Rolled Alloy Steel Bars — Specification
scope_description: This standard covers the requirements for hot rolled alloy steel bars for the production of bright bars and machine parts for general engineering applications. It applies to all types of hot-rolled products in straight lengths in sections that are uniform throughout their length. It does not apply to the grades of alloy steel bars covered in other Indian Standards such as IS 1875, IS 5517, IS 4432, IS 3930, IS 3748, IS 9550, IS 3195, IS 3431, IS 11169 (Part 1), IS 6603 and IS 11169 (Part 2).

product_keywords: hot rolled alloy steel bars, alloy steel, bright bars, machine parts, general engineering, nickel steel, chromium steel, molybdenum steel, chromium molybdenum steel, manganese steel, silicon alloyed steel, boron steel, resulphurized steel

Deleted phrase '(from where this requirement has extracted)' in clause 11.2; substituted text in clause 11.7 para 1 (twist determination methods, at manufacturer's discretion); substituted clause 11.7 para 4 (twist measurement reference to Fig. 6).
